references.text: Moses was commanded to place the staffs before the testimony of the Lord in the tabernacle
The testimony (the law) was placed in the ark, and the tent of the testimony was the place where God met with his people
The tabernacle is called the tabernacle of the testimony, the same place where Moses laid down the staffs
The tent of the testimony (the tent of meeting) was the place where Aaron and his sons served before the Lord
Aaron's staff was later placed back before the testimony as a sign
The Epistle to the Hebrews mentions that Aaron's staff, which had budded, was kept in the ark along with the testimony
